biggest_catch: Very long Election Day: 5:00 a.m. to approximately 11:00 p.m. (about 18 hours); training pay only if you complete your Election Day tour.
catches: Election Day runs 5:00 a.m.-~11:00 p.m., about 18 hours on site.
Training is paid only if you complete the Election Day tour of duty.
Must assist with polling-site setup prior to Election Day.
Non-residents need a signed employment waiver from an adjacent county.

c1.evidence: Official Fulton County Department of Registration and Elections 'Election Day Poll Workers' page (fultoncountyga.gov, crawled 2026-09-23).

c2.evidence: Official county recruitment (fultoncountyga.gov, Dec 2023, 2024 cycle): 'Poll workers can make up to $400 for working on election day.' Current official page: must work 5 a.m.-~11 p.m. Election Day; training paid if tour of duty completed.

c3.evidence: No fee to apply or serve.

c4.evidence: Flat-fee election work; no risk capital.

eligibility: US citizen, 16+, read/write English; Fulton County resident or signed waiver from adjacent county; in-person training; available 5am-11pm Election Day plus setup.
notes: Fulton County GA — Census 2025 pop rank 105 (101-200 lane). Pay figure is the county's most recent official published rate ('up to $400', 2024 cycle recruitment); county is actively recruiting for the Nov 3, 2026 midterm (Aug 2026 county news) but has not published 2026-specific rates. The county's older 2022 pay schedule ($175-$275 by role) appears superseded; current third-party reporting corroborates $275-$400. Hours (5am-11pm) and training-pay terms are from the current official page.

steps: Confirm eligibility: US citizen, 16+, read/write English, Fulton County resident (or get an adjacent-county employment waiver).
Submit the employment application via the Fulton County poll worker portal.
Complete required in-person training prior to the election.
Assist with polling-site setup prior to Election Day.
Work Election Day 5:00 a.m.-~11:00 p.m.; training pay follows completion of the tour.
timing: Election Day 5am-11pm (~18 hrs) plus required in-person training and pre-Election-Day setup.
